name: Chesterfield Armchair
descriptions: A deep, tufted leather armchair in classic dark brown with rolled arms and brass studs.
Weighty and immovable once placed; meant to be a focal seating piece in a living room or study.

name: Tall Oak Bookshelf
descriptions: A sturdy, floor-to-ceiling bookshelf made of finished oak with five adjustable shelves.
Classic paneled sides and a modest crown moulding give it a timeless appearance suitable for a study or parlor.

name: Brass Floor Lamp
descriptions: A tall brass lamp with a fabric drum shade that casts warm, ambient light ideal for reading corners.
Weighted base prevents tipping; classic styling complements both traditional and transitional interiors.

name: Landscape Oil Painting (Gilded Frame)
descriptions: An oil landscape in muted earth tones set in an ornate gilded frame for a vintage look.
Wall-mounted artwork that instantly adds a classic, sophisticated atmosphere to a room.

name: Marble Mantel Clock
descriptions: A compact mantel clock with a polished marble base and brass clock face; soft ticking provides a gentle presence.
Classic accessory for a fireplace mantel, sideboard, or bookshelf that reinforces a traditional aesthetic.

name: Persian-Style Wool Rug (Large)
descriptions: A large handlike-patterned wool rug in deep reds and blues, designed to anchor a seating area.
Lays flat on the floor; provides visual warmth and sound dampening in classic interior arrangements.

name: Ceramic Floor Vase
descriptions: A tall glazed ceramic vase with subtle crackle finish, suitable for dried branches or as a standalone sculpture.
Heavy and stable when filled; contributes an elegant vertical accent to corners or entryways.

name: Gilded Framed Mirror
descriptions: A medium-sized wall mirror in a carved gilded frame that reflects light and heightens a room's classic character.
Intended to be hung; adds depth and a sense of space to entry halls or living rooms.

name: Potted Indoor Fern
descriptions: A medium ceramic pot containing a lush fern; brings a bit of greenery and a softening organic touch indoors.
Meant to sit on a stand or floor; requires light and occasional watering, but functions as a decorative houseplant.

name: Scented Candle Set (Boxed)
descriptions: A boxed set of three classic-scented votive candles in neutral glass holders for mood lighting and fragrance.
Portable, can be placed on tables or shelves; sold together in a small retail box.

name: Decorative Throw Pillow (Pair)
descriptions: A matched pair of velvet throw pillows with piped edges in a muted jewel tone to complement a classic sofa.
Soft and compressible; intended as removable soft furnishings that can be stacked or stored.

name: Picture Hanging Kit
descriptions: A small kit containing wire, hooks, and a pair of wall anchors for safely hanging framed art and mirrors.
Handy accessory for installing the other furniture items in the bundle; compact and easy to store.

name: Mid-Century Lounge Sofa
descriptions: Three-seat sofa with tapered walnut legs and a gently curved back inspired by 1950s design.
Tufted cushions upholstered in muted teal boucle; comfortable for lounging or entertaining.
Solid hardwood frame and a low, elegant silhouette that suits retro and modern interiors.

name: Industrial Reclaimed Coffee Table
descriptions: Low coffee table with a reclaimed oak slab top and a blackened steel frame.
Visible nail holes and a hand-sanded finish give it an authentic, workshop-made feel.
Includes a slatted lower shelf for magazines and a sturdy surface for heavy use.

name: Ornate Carved Oak Sideboard (Antique)
descriptions: Heavy oak sideboard with carved floral panels and solid brass drawer pulls.
Deep storage behind paneled doors for tableware; the top is ideal for display.
Patinaed finish and slightly uneven surfaces that speak to authentic age and craftsmanship.

name: Minimalist Platform Bed Frame
descriptions: Low-profile wooden platform bed with clean lines and a matte finish.
Slatted base for mattress support eliminates need for a box spring.
Design favors simplicity and function; pairs well with Scandinavian or modern decor.

name: Handwoven Bohemian Wool Rug (Large)
descriptions: Handwoven wool rug with an eclectic mix of saturated colors and geometric patterns.
Fringed edges and a slightly uneven weave add artisanal character.
Thick pile gives warmth underfoot and anchors seating areas in casual interiors.

name: Moroccan Leather Pouf
descriptions: Round pouf crafted from stitched and dyed leather; comfortable as extra seating or a footrest.
Hand-stitched pattern and a slightly distressed finish for an authentic, lived-in look.
Lightweight enough to move around but substantial in presence for boho or global-inspired rooms.

name: Art Deco Brass Floor Lamp
descriptions: Tall floor lamp with stepped brass accents and a frosted glass globe shade.
Warm, directional light ideal for reading nooks or as an ambient statement piece.
Geometric details and a polished finish that recall 1920s glamour.

name: Sculptural Pendant Light (Modern)
descriptions: Multi-arm pendant with asymmetrical metal shades in matte black and brass.
Designed to hang over dining tables or living spaces and serve as a visual focal point.
Clean modern lines combine with an artistic silhouette for gallery-style interiors.

name: Large Abstract Canvas Painting
descriptions: Oversized stretched canvas featuring bold brushstrokes and a high-contrast color study.
Gallery-ready when hung; provides an immediate artistic direction and focal wall interest.
Unframed edges with visible texture from layered paint and palette knife work.

name: Vintage Brass Mirror (Ornate Frame)
descriptions: Large wall mirror with an ornate brass frame showing natural tarnish and character.
Reflective surface enlarges space; frame pattern works with classical and eclectic decor.
Heavy and best mounted securely to a solid wall; the finish is intentionally aged.

name: Kinetic Metal Mobile Sculpture
descriptions: Delicate hanging mobile made of balanced metal elements that rotate gently in air currents.
Modern, contemplative decoration that animates ceilings or entryways with subtle motion.
Lightweight components but requires a hook or secure suspension point to display.

name: Set of Three Ceramic Vases (Glazed)
descriptions: A trio of differently sized glazed ceramic vases in complementary tones.
Smooth, tactile finish and narrow necks suited to single stems or small floral groupings.
Sold as a coordinated decorative set; fragile and best handled with care.

name: Throw Pillow Bundle (Assorted Textiles)
descriptions: Set of four decorative throw pillows featuring mixed fabrics: linen, velvet, and woven cotton.
Various sizes and patterns allow easy mixing; lightweight and easy to move between rooms.
Machine-washable covers on zippers; ideal for adding quick color or texture.

name: Shoji Screen Room Divider
descriptions: Three-panel Japanese shoji screen with rice-paper inserts and a slim wooden frame.
Allows filtered light to pass while creating a subtle partition for privacy or staging.
Lightweight but tall; folds flat for storage and suits minimalist or zen-inspired rooms.

name: Indoor Plant Stand with Terracotta Pots
descriptions: Tiered metal plant stand holding three terracotta pots, sized for small houseplants.
Elevates greenery for display and improves airflow around plants; rust-resistant finish.
Functional and decorative, bridging botanical and interior design elements.

name: pillow
descriptions: A soft, fluffy pillow on the bed.
